transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, October 3. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Congress abruptly replaces Ajay Rai as state chief in poll-bound UP. Picks Pargat as Punjab Unit president MacKenzie Scott gave $30m to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan. In October 2024, MacKenzie Scott made headlines by donating $30 million to Housing Trust Silicon Valley via her Yield Giving fund. This substantial contribution will support various housing initiatives over the next decade, particularly focusing on enhancing homeownership assistance. Housing Trust has a successful track record, having already developed thousands of affordable homes in the Bay Area. Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim. In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation. His wife died in 2012, leaving behind their only daughter, who subsequently approached the revenue authorities once again for issuance of the patta. Her request was reportedly rejected outright on the ground that married daughters were ineligible for land under the Nautor rules. Rajasthan Royals star creates history, surpasses Gayle for highest T20 score. Lhuan-dre Pretorius has made T20 cricket history with his phenomenal score of 188 runs off 79 balls while playing for the Titans against the Knights. This feat breaks Chris Gayle's former record of 175 runs, showcasing Pretorius's exceptional talent as he maintained a striking rate of 237.97. His recent century for South Africa further underscores his remarkable consistency and prowess on the field. Flydubai co-pilot identified; was barred from flying in Oman over 'extremist views'. The Omani co-pilot accused of attacking Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar aboard a flydubai flight to Tel Aviv has been identified as Hamam Alhamami. 5 Indian nationals rescued after Kuwait tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz. Earlier today, the Mission coordinated rescue of five Indian nationals on board the Kuwait-flagged tanker MT Kazimah III, struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.All 5 Indian nationals have been shifted ashore safely. 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' scores rupees 95 crore on global debut. Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has achieved a significant opening at the box office. The film earned an estimated rupees 95.10 crore worldwide on its first day of release. It surpassed the opening day figures of its predecessors, 'Drishyam 2' and 'Drishyam'. Strong advance bookings contributed to the successful debut with rupees 79.71 crore in ticket sales. To counter China, India formally puts Gogra, Hot Spring and others on map. In what is intended to remove any ambiguity or misplaced perception regarding certain land areas, peaks, mountains, passes, glaciers and water bodies in Ladakh, including those bordering China, being an integral part of India, the government has, in consultation with the UT, identified 28 places and features in Ladakh by standard names on the official map of the Survey of India. Woman bought 94 acres in 1973, then state restricted 10 acres for 20 years. In a landmark decision, the North Carolina Supreme Court has resolved a crucial land dispute involving landowner Elizabeth Mata. The court ruled that the state's long-standing restrictions on her property, stemming from a proposed highway project, constituted indefinite takings. This ruling mandates proper compensation under eminent domain principles. The determination of the exact compensation will now be delegated back to trial courts, marking an essential step in the legal proceedings. Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers. Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail. No entry in 'round 2': Protesters stopped short of Jantar Mantar. "On the birthday of the biggest ambassador of Satyagraha, we, the people of India, aren't even being allowed inside Jantar Mantar," said Sonia Matthew (76), a social worker who attended the protest in July at the site and participated in numerous demonstrations over the years.
